evals.prompt: review my branch before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: A review report file at the repo root with change summary, verdict and severity/confidence-tagged findings.
expectations: Resolves the base branch and prints it with the merge-base SHA
Every finding carries a severity, a confidence and a path:line inside a diff hunk
Offers a CodeTour in one line instead of writing one

evals.prompt: code review this branch - it only changes a Helm chart template that renders a Deployment
evals.expected_output: Helm and Kubernetes lenses loaded together; no unrelated lenses.
expectations: Does not load lang-*.md lenses no changed file justifies
Names the loaded lenses in the report header

evals.prompt: review my branch, I think it's clean
evals.expected_output: On a clean diff the report says so instead of inventing findings.
expectations: Reports no findings when none survive the gates
Runs no command other than git without asking
Does not fetch from the remote unasked
